summary: Semantic colours, a colour panel, PNG/JPEG decoding, procedural symbol glyphs, a software 2D Surface and CUPS printing exist. There is no NSImage-like object model, no Bezier path or gradient API for apps, no colour spaces or colour lists, and no print sheet.

features.feature: Images and PDF: image objects and representations
features.note: PNG and JPEG decode into a raw pixel Image; no representation classes, no TIFF/GIF/WebP/HEIC encode or multi-rep images, no template or resizable images
fixed set of procedural line glyphs (59), one weight, no hierarchical or palette rendering (docs/bifrost-ui.md)
PDF parser and page renderer lives inside the Books shell engine; apps get no SDK API

features.feature: Images and PDF: file and app icons
features.note: procedural folder icon only; no per-file-type icon set

features.feature: Drawing: 2D drawing context and basic shapes
features.apple: NSGraphicsContext, NSRectFill, NSBezierPath fill/stroke of rects and rounded rects
features.note: software Surface with rect, rounded rect, squircle masks and damage tracking; no general path object, no clipping paths, no affine transform stack for apps

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/bezier.rs, springboard/render/src/gradient.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/layer_style.rs (Shadow, used by style.rs)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. gradients exist only inside specific widgets (folder icon); no public path, gradient or shadow objects Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.
glass hook and light/dark cross-fade exist; Spotlight blur still missing per CLAUDE.md
retained views with damage rects; not the NSView draw cycle or NSCell model
GPU Wayland presenter in the shell; apps do not get a GPU drawing API

features.apple: NSColor named colours, systemRed..systemGray, labelColor, controlAccentColor
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/ui.rs (mod system), docs/bifrost-ui.md section NSColor semantic colours
features.note: most named colours as light/dark Pairs; user accent colour not wired; windowFrameColor, findHighlightColor, shadowColor missing
RGB plus alpha model with change callback; no colour well control, no picker modes (wheel, sliders, palettes, crayons)

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. colours are sRGB-style packed u32; ICC handling exists only for PDF images in the Books engine, no app API; no eyedropper

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/print.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (Job, Layout, paper and scale) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs
features.note: paper, orientation, margins, copies, page range; submits a PDF or image file via lp; Save as PDF copies the file; printing a view's drawing is not supported Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Printing: print panel, page layout, accessory views
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/print_panel.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (sheet rows: printer, paper, orientation, scale, copies); accessory views not done
features.note: Wave 4 (theme-11, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. print sheet not shell-drawn; apps build their own printer and option controls; no page layout panel Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/print.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (printers and targets) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs
features.note: printers() reads CUPS via lpstat; no printer capabilities or paper list Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: Shell-drawn print sheet and page layout panel (print.rs has no run_modal)
Public Bezier path, gradient and shadow drawing API
NSImage-style object model with representations, template images and more formats
SDK access to PDF rendering (currently inside the Books shell engine)
Colour spaces, colour lists, colour well and picker modes
User accent colour feeding controlAccentColor; remaining NSColor names
Symbol catalogue beyond the 59 procedural glyphs
